title: Naam
desc: A dreaded terrorist's attempt at fleeing the country forever is foiled by the police and his brother is killed in the shootout. He then employs four out-of-work youths to hijack a plane.

title: Parthale Parvasam
desc: Madhava and Simi's marriage comes to an end after she discovers that he has a love child. However, they remain friends and end up finding suitable partners for each other.

title: Movie
desc: A captivating tale of love, action, and drama unfolds as fate brings two contrasting lives together, testing their limits in a world filled with challenges, choices, and destiny.
